name: Time picker
summary: A modal dialog for choosing an hour and minute, with an optional AM/PM period. It has two interchangeable modes — an analog clock dial and a pair of numeric text fields — toggled in place inside the same container.

inputs.name: hour
inputs.description: Selected hour, 0-23 internally regardless of 12/24-hour display.

inputs.name: onTimeChange
inputs.description: Called with the new hour and minute as the dial, chips or input fields change them.

inputs.name: is24Hour
inputs.description: Shows 24-hour entry with an inner dial ring and no AM/PM period selector. Defaults to the platform's locale-derived clock format.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Analog clock selection vs. numeric text-field entry. Both modes share one selection state; switching modes does not lose an in-progress hour/minute.

inputs.name: layoutType
inputs.description: Landscape vs. portrait arrangement of the selectors. Defaults to a value chosen from the current orientation.

anatomy.name: Headline
anatomy.description: Small label above the selectors ("Select time").

anatomy.name: Time selector
anatomy.description: Two chips (hour, minute) showing large digits, separated by a colon; the active chip is highlighted, the other is not. Dial mode only.

anatomy.name: Period selector
anatomy.description: AM/PM segmented toggle, positioned beside or below the time selector; absent entirely in 24-hour mode.

anatomy.name: Clock dial
anatomy.description: A circular face with 12 evenly spaced number labels; a selector line runs from the dial's center to a handle marking the current value, with a small dot at the center. Dial mode only.

anatomy.name: Mode-toggle icon button
anatomy.description: Switches between dial and keyboard-input modes; part of the dialog's actions row, not the token groups.

anatomy.name: Time input fields
anatomy.description: Input mode only: two outlined numeric text fields (hour, minute) replacing the dial, plus the same period selector.

anatomy.name: Actions row
anatomy.description: Cancel/OK text buttons, owned by the surrounding dialog spec, not by these token groups.

variants.description: Default visual selection via the clock dial.
Fast keyboard entry, or an accessibility fallback.
Adds the AM/PM period selector. Uses both token groups.
Drops the period selector; the dial gains an inner ring for hours 13-23 and 00, sized by comp.time-picker.time-selector24-h-vertical-container-width.

layout.text: The dial's outer number ring sits at a radius of 101/256 of the dial diameter; in 24-hour hour mode only, an inner ring sits at 69/256. Both are ratios of clock-dial-container-size, not absolute distances, so they scale with the dial's tokenized size.

Hour labels are 12, 1 through 11, spaced 30 degrees apart; minute labels are 0, 5, ..., 55, also spaced 30 degrees apart but each representing a 5-minute step. Labels are placed by a generic polar layout, not a fixed grid.

The selector's reach is computed at runtime as the current dial diameter times the ring ratio, minus half the handle's tokenized size, so the handle always lands just inside the number ring rather than at the dial's edge.

In 24-hour mode, the hour selected depends on drag/tap distance from the dial center: inside a 74dp radius selects the inner-ring (13-23, 00) hour; outside it selects the outer-ring (1-12) hour. This threshold is fixed regardless of the tokenized dial size.
Vertical layout leaves a 36dp gap between the numeric display and the dial, and a 24dp gap below the dial before the actions row.

In the input mode's vertical period selector, the AM and PM rows are 40dp visually and separated by an 8dp gap, then a 16dp gap to a 24dp toggle icon; every row's actual tap target is padded to 48dp regardless of its visual size, so visual and touch geometry diverge by design.
The legacy (non-updated) AM/PM toggle is a single bordered segmented control: two items split by a 1dp divider, with the container's tokenized shape applied only to the outer corners of each half.

states.text: The active chip (hour or minute) uses time-selector-selected-container-color with hover, focus and pressed label-colour variants; the inactive chip uses time-selector-unselected-container-color with its own hover/focus/pressed variants.

behaviour.text: Tapping the clock dial snaps immediately to a value: minutes snap to the nearest 5-minute tick, hours snap to the nearest whole hour. Tapping the hour ring in minute-auto-switch mode advances to minute selection after roughly a 100ms delay.

Dragging the dial tracks the pointer continuously and resolves to whole-minute or whole-hour increments while moving — finer-grained than a tap — and only settles onto the released value; there is no visible re-snap after release beyond the already-continuous angle.

Selecting hour vs. minute crossfades the ring's labels (12 hour numbers versus 12 five-minute numbers) using the default-effects spring; the selector's rotation to a newly tapped or dragged angle uses the default-spatial spring.
The mode toggle (dial to input) swaps the whole selector area; no cross-fade or slide choreography is specified beyond the standard content swap — treat it as an instant or simple-fade swap.
Clicking the already-active AM/PM segment is a no-op; clicking the inactive one adds or subtracts 12 hours from the current value, and is disabled while the hour input itself is invalid.

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab move between the time-selector chips, dial numbers, period segments and action buttons; dial focus order loops within the outer ring and, in 24-hour mode, bridges to the inner ring at each end so it never dead-ends off the dial.
Arrow keys move the focused dial number or period segment to its neighbour.
Enter or Space selects the focused value or activates the focused button.
Escape or a platform back action dismisses the enclosing dialog.
semantics: Every dial number, the AM/PM segments and the time-selector chips are keyboard-focusable with a 48dp minimum interactive size, independent of their tokenized visual size.
Each dial number announces a full accessible label, e.g. "1 o'clock" or "05 minutes", not just the bare digit.
Text-input fields mark an error state with an inline message on invalid hour/minute entry, mirroring the date picker's input-validation pattern.

notes.text: time-picker (dial) and time-input (fields) are two faces of one component sharing selection state — switching modes must not lose an in-progress hour or minute.

The Compose source still routes clock-dial and mode-toggle motion through the global MotionScheme rather than per-component tokens (marked with a TODO in source); treat the springs named here as current defaults, not fixed component tokens.
Do not build the AM/PM toggle as two independent buttons — it behaves as one mutually-exclusive segmented control with shared border/divider styling.

An Expressive "vibrant" time picker with scroll-wheel selectors (TimeScroll, VibrantTimePickerDialog) exists in this Compose source but does not correspond to comp.time-picker/comp.time-input and is out of scope for this spec — do not add it as a variant.
